answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is to make voting power depend on scarce, attested work rather than on cheap new identities. Each account must first pay a one-time proof-of-work and then keep publishing original challenge answers that peers countersign; copies are rejected on the ledger. A sudden nebula of sockpuppets then stalls at the same narrow reef of unique effort, unable to berth at the settlement wharf until a real history of attested work exists.
